Name: (CP)MoreParsnips
Author: GodRabbit
Description:
This mod adds several new Parsnip seeds that can be crafted from the start. Most of the seeds are gradually condensed Parsnips.


You can condense 10 Parsnip Seeds into 1 Silver Parsnip seeds, 10 silver seeds into Golden parsnip seeds and so on, up until Prismatic Parsnip.


[b]Please Note[/b]: Trying to achieve Perfection with this mod would probably be a nightmare, so don't add it to a perfection run without thinking it through!


[center][b][size=4]If you like the mod and want more Parsnips, let me know. If you find any problem please post it here so I can fix it ASAP.
Thank you for downloading and playing[/size][/b][/center]
[b][size=5]New Crops[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Silver Parsnip[/size][/b]
You can get 1 Silver Parsnip seeds by crafting it with 10 regular Parsnip seeds.


[list]
[*]Grows in Spring & Summer.
[*]Takes 4 days to grow.
[*]Produce sells for 350G
[*]Universally liked gift
[/list]
[size=4][b]Golden Parsnip[/b][/size]
You can get 1 Golden Parsnip seeds by crafting it with 10 Silver Parsnip seeds (Total of 100 Parsnip seeds).

[list]
[*]Grows in Spring, Summer & Fall.
[*]Takes 4 days to grow.
[*]Produce sells for 3500G
[*]Universally liked gift
[/list]
[b][size=4]Iridium Parsnip[/size][/b]
You can get 1 Iridium Parsnip seeds by crafting it with 10 Golden Parsnip seeds (Total of 1000 Parsnip seeds).

[list]
[*]Grows year-round.
[*]Takes 4 days to grow.
[*]Produce sells for 35,000G
[*]May produce 1 more
[*]Universally loved gift
[/list]

[b][size=4]Prismatic Parsnip[/size][/b]
You can get 1 Prismatic Parsnip seeds by crafting it with 10 Iridium Parsnip seeds (Total of 10,000 Parsnip seeds).

[list]
[*]Grows year-round.
[*]Take 4 days to grow.
[*]Produce sells for 350,000G
[*]May produce 2 more
[*]Universally loved gift
[/list]

[size=4][b]Yobsnip[/b][/size]
You can get 1 Yobsnip seeds by crafting it with 100 Prismatic Parsnip seeds (Total of 1,000,000 Parsnip seeds).

[list]
[*]Grows year-round.
[*]Takes 4 days to grow.
[*]Produce sells for 35,000,000G
[*]Universally loved gift
[/list]
[size=4][b]Joja Parsnip[/b][/size]
You can get 1 Joja Parsnip seeds by crafting 1 Parsnip seeds + 10 Joja Cola (The recipe can be bought from Joja or from Pierre after year 2)

[list]
[*]Grows in Spring & Summer.
[*]Takes 4 days to grow.
[*]Produce sells for 40G
[*]May produce 2 more and even more with higher Farming Level
[/list]
[size=4][b]Halfsnip[/b][/size]
You can craft 2 Halfsnip seeds from 1 Parsnip seeds.

[list]
[*]Grows in Spring.
[*]Takes 2 days to grow.
[*]Produce sells for 17G
[*]Universally hated gift.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Voidsnip[/b][/size]
You can craft the seeds from 1 Parsnip Seeds + 5 Void Essence + 5 Bat Wings + 1 coal (Recipe can be bought from Krobus).

[list]
[*]Grows in Winter.
[*]Takes 4 days to grow.
[*]Produce sells for 795G.
[*]Universally hated gift.
[*]Loved gift for Krobus.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Lovesnip[/b][/size]
You can get Lovesnip seeds from a full-friendship Parsnip Pet (or one of it's breeds).

[list]
[*]Grows in Spring & Summer
[*]Takes 4 days to grow.
[*]Produce sells for 2100.
[*]Universally loved gift.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Pets[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Parsnip Pet[/b][/size]
Can be chosen from the start or bought from Marnie for 2000G.


The beginning cutscene still refers to it as "cat" and it meows. I can change it, but I kinda find it funny they way it is, so maybe in another update.


[list]
[*]Has 50% of giving a gift each day
[*]May give 2 Parsnip Seeds after 1 heart of friendship (85% chance).
[*]May give 2 Silver Parsnip Seeds after 3 hearts of friendship (10% chance)
[*]May give 1 Golden Parsnip after full friendship (5% chance)
[*]Gives 1 Lovesnip Seeds after full friendship (~2% chance). These seeds are exculsive to this pet.
[*]Has a breed that can bought from Marnie for 2500G
[/list]
